//: Which mods each build ships. Entries are folder names under mods/ (data-only mods) or built .nrm files (code mods). A mod not listed here ships nowhere: example mods and code-mod source folders stay out. Desktop: tools/mods/stage_mods.cmake stages next to the exe (and into dist/ for Release). Android: android/app/build.gradle bundleMods packs into the APK. Web: web/page.cmake puts them in the page's .data, with the code mods' code recompiled ahead of time; no instruction-patch mods (long_tow_cable.nrm: librecomp regenerates the patched functions at load with LiveRecomp, which a page can't run), no native mods (online play needs sockets a page doesn't have) and no quit prompt (a page can't quit). Native mods (multiplayer-native) are built by the game's CMake and staged from build/built_mods. On Android libmultiplayer_native.so is packed with the game libraries and bundleMods ships the mod.json and menu.
